specs.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished mascot design RESEARCH SHEET, landscape 1536x1024. Entire background edge-to-edge FLAT warm paper #f4f2ed, NOT white, no paper texture, no gradients. A kettlebell character, unmistakably real training equipment: solid cast round iron body with flat resting bottom; single thick arched handle attached at both shoulders with a LARGE OPEN HOLE; two tiny paper-colored dot eyes high on body; paper-colored cast number 16 centered below eyes. No mouth. Flat matte black #111110 silhouette, no 3D lighting. ONE tiny burnt orange #ff7a1f tape wrap on one side of the handle. Adult, quiet, grounded, dry humor, never cute. No arms, legs, gloves, feet, blush, large shiny eyes, sweat, teeth, muscles, aggression, blue, AI motifs, calorie or body-weight references, streaks, phones, UI, logos of existing brands, orange circles, Headspace characters. Keep identical construction, handle attachment, eyes and number throughout all poses. Number is always 16 except waiting pose uses 0. Anatomy consistency is more important than dramatic deformation. Layout: left third has ONE large isolated standing hero with generous blank space around it, no overlaps or nearby captions, occupying x=80..490 y=160..620. On right two columns by three rows of SIX clearly separated poses with small exact Russian labels underneath, in reading order: «Привет» handle tilts slightly like a raised hat but stays attached; «Разминка» stretches vertically; «Мах» whole kettlebell tilts along ONE thin black motion arc; «Отдых» gently squashed on flat bottom, eyes closed arcs; «Ждём» neutral still pose, number 0; «Есть!» tiny hop, one small orange spark. For «Есть!» spark REPLACES orange handle tape so there is only one orange detail in that pose. Bottom strip: isolated pure BLACK SILHOUETTE with open handle hole but NO EYES, NO NUMBER, NO TAPE; then a light and dark 60-style rounded-square application icon, monochrome silhouette only, no extra badges. Simple top-left sheet label, exact Russian text «Гиря». Keep hero and all six poses full-body, clearly separated. No additional props or characters. Execution G1: FLAT GEOMETRIC. Precise circular body and clean semicircular handle; exact smooth edges; uniform fill. Moderate compact proportions, body wider than handle. Clean geometric graphic design.
